value.hook: Read before using process environment diagnostics as public route evidence.
value.title: Filtered environment diagnostics are not secret-safe captures

sections.name: body
sections.value:
A pipeline that filters `ps -Eww` output still reads the process environment. Filtering with `tr` and `grep` is not structured environment parsing or secret redaction, and does not establish that captured stdout is safe for transcripts or public receipts. Prefer the recorded route/status for published evidence; do not execute an environment diagnostic during a review merely to verify a stamp.

In #263, the daemon carries a fixed cache-proxy stamp using verified PID/start ancestry; it adds no environment or token reader. The manual diagnostic in `docs/difficulties.md:175` is a separate operator action, not the production implementation. No actual token disclosure was established and no live environment was inspected. Keep those claims separate when grading d-2 / PRD 004 req-02.

Magic wand: a secret-free route-lineage diagnostic would make it unnecessary to suggest environment captures when investigating a displayed route.
